feedback.delta: Split immutable identity, user-configured narrative, verified runtime capability, current health and subjective projection. Historical SelfKnowledge mixed these authority classes and therefore drifted.
Add tests for >2-segment capability discovery, malformed teachable mapping fail-closed behavior, declared-vs-live vision mismatch, and self-output reinforcement without external success receipts.
Keep raw observation, learned mapping/prototype, trust/provenance, calibration, projection and rollback/supersession state distinct. Learned familiarity is not sensor truth.
Encode identity_fact, runtime_observation, learned_mapping, calibration/conflict, subjective_projection and verified_outcome as distinct typed semantics with no implicit authority upgrade.
Body/agency projections may enter workspace selection, but confident/verbose self-output must not earn causal credit without verified outcome/state change.
Graph edges for familiarity/self-description need ancestry and evidence-class labels so activation/repetition cannot masquerade as truth support.
Repeated internal activation can monotonically inflate historical embodiment/affect scalars; emergence metrics must lesion/shuffle external grounding and separate recurrence from causal contribution.
Preserve the mapping/persistence pattern, but do not port scalar reinforcement or static self-description authority into Clay 0.1.
